description: This file declares the UccSerializer interface within the beerocks namespace, which provides a contract for serializing UCC reply strings into byte buffers for network transmission. It includes a pure virtual method serialize_reply and is intended to be implemented by classes that handle message serialization logic for socket communication.

classes.name: UccSerializer
classes.description: Interface for serializing UCC reply strings into byte buffers for transmission over network sockets.

methods.name: serialize_reply
methods.description: Serializes a UCC reply string into a byte buffer, returning true if successful and false if the message does not fit into the buffer.
